output.sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(o.net_revenue) / COUNT(*), 2) AS average_order_value_eur FROM marts.fct_orders o WHERE o.is_revenue = true AND o.order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01' AND o.order_date < DATE '2026-01-01'
output.explanation: AOV is net revenue of completed orders divided by the number of completed orders. Filtering fct_orders to is_revenue = true (status = 'completed') with order_date in calendar year 2025 (fiscal year equals calendar year). Result rounded to 2 decimals.
